def parse_demo(text,n):
    m=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {n} output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance)',text,re.S)
    assert m, 'not found'
    h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2))
    parse=lambda s:[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
    a,b=parse(m.group(3)),parse(m.group(4))
    assert len(a)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in a)
    assert len(b)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in b)
    return a,b

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    hr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row[0]!=0 and all(v==row[0] for v in row)]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c]!=0 and all(row[c]==grid[0][c] for row in grid)]
    if not hr or not vc:
        return out
    # Separator color and panel boundaries
    sep=grid[hr[0]][0]
    row_edges=[-1]+hr+[h]
    col_edges=[-1]+vc+[w]
    panels=[]
    for ri in range(len(row_edges)-1):
        r0,r1=row_edges[ri]+1,row_edges[ri+1]
        rowpan=[]
        for ci in range(len(col_edges)-1):
            c0,c1=col_edges[ci]+1,col_edges[ci+1]
            vals={grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c]!=0 and grid[r][c]!=sep}
            rowpan.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,vals))
        panels.append(rowpan)
    for ri in range(len(panels)-1):
        for ci in range(len(panels[0])-1):
            block=[panels[ri][ci],panels[ri][ci+1],panels[ri+1][ci],panels[ri+1][ci+1]]
            occupied=[p for p in block if p[4]]
            empty=[p for p in block if not p[4]]
            colors=set.union(*(p[4] for p in occupied)) if occupied else set()
            if len(occupied)!=3 or len(colors)!=1 or any(len(p[4])!=1 for p in occupied):
                continue
            missing=empty[0]
            mr0,mr1,mc0,mc1,_=missing
            # Complete only when the other panel in the same row is occupied.
            source=panels[ri if missing in block[0:2] else ri+1][ci+1 if missing in (block[0],block[2]) else ci]
            sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,svals=source
            if not svals or (mr1-mr0)!=(sr1-sr0) or (mc1-mc0)!=(sc1-sc0):
                continue
            for dr in range(mr1-mr0):
                for dc in range(mc1-mc0):
                    out[mr0+dr][mc0+dc]=grid[sr0+dr][sc1-1-dc]
    return out

for i,(a,b) in enumerate((demo1,demo2),1):
    got=transform(a)
    print(i,got==b, [(r,c) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(len(a[0])) if got[r][c]!=b[r][c]][:10])
